description: This file contains a JUnit test class 'MessageSourceServiceTest' for testing the 'MessageSourceService' in the OpenMRS system. It verifies the behavior of message retrieval when localization is missing, ensuring the service correctly returns error codes.

classes.name: MessageSourceServiceTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class that tests the behavior of the MessageSourceService in handling message localization and error codes within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: getMessage_shouldReturnTheLastErrorCodeIfnoLocalizationIsFound
methods.description: Test method verifying that if no localization is found, the MessageSourceService returns the last error code from a MessageSourceResolvable object.
